hints.title: Closed Form Formulation
hints.text: Total sum of integers from 1 up to n is n * (n + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Divisible Multiples
hints.text: Multiples of m in range 1..n form an arithmetic progression m, 2m, ..., km where k = n // m.

hints.title: Algebraic Difference
hints.text: Subtracting twice the sum of multiples from the total sum yields num1 - num2 in O(1) time.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def differenceOfSums(self, n: int, m: int) -> int:
        total = n * (n + 1) // 2
        k = n // m
        div_sum = m * k * (k + 1) // 2
        return total - 2 * div_sum
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping 1..n takes O(n), whereas formula takes O(1).
